The results of this meta-analysis indicate that lung cancer patients with COPD are at an elevated risk of developing IRP, particularly when exposed to higher levels of radiation therapy. The finding that this increased risk persists across different levels of radiation exposure (< 40% and ≥ 40%) suggests that COPD is an independent risk factor for IRP, and when combined with the risk associated with radiation therapy, may compound the likelihood of this adverse event.
